hypotheses.P0_jacobian_variation_is_low_rank: The first 16 FineWeb modes explain at least 80 percent of centered Jacobian variance.
hypotheses.P1_rank32_dictionary_is_high_fidelity: Mean plus 32 frozen modes reconstructs total Jacobian energy with fidelity at least 0.95 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P2_rank64_dictionary_is_nearly_complete: Mean plus 64 modes reaches fidelity at least 0.98 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P3_mode_dictionary_transfers_ood: At rank 32, each OOD fidelity is within 0.03 of disjoint FineWeb.
hypotheses.P4_spectrum_has_random_matrix_outliers: The leading centered singular value is at least 1.5 times the maximum leading value across three independently column-shuffled nulls.
hypotheses.P5_mean_transport_is_not_enough: The mean-only reconstruction has fidelity below 0.90 on every corpus.
